scenarios.name: Expand and collapse Origin children from its context menu

scenario_steps.name: a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is collapsed in the model browser
its context menu offers Expand All Children and Collapse All Children
the user chooses Expand All Children
Origin displays its plane, axis and center-point child rows
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user right-clicks Origin and chooses Collapse All Children
the direct plane, axis and center-point rows remain visible under Origin
the solid remains visible in the viewport
